respondent_model: same model family as coordinator via Agent tool general-purpose subagents; exact per-agent model not exposed
concurrency_plan: Platform limit: 20 concurrent subagents. Batches of up to 20 respondent agents (pilot of 1, then 10, then 20, then 20...). One launch attempt of 5 agents (W052-W056) was refused by the limit and re-launched later; not an execution failure of any respondent.
isolation_limitations: Each respondent agent is a fresh subagent given only its own payload path and output path. Agents share the same filesystem and tools, so isolation is instruction-level, not a security sandbox; agents could technically read other files. Payload files are staged outside the repo.
